up: Retrieve IC50 activity data in nM against target CHEMBL284 (Dipeptidyl peptidase 4). Filter for assays where target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return exactly these columns: canonical_smiles, compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. For pubmed_id_or_doi, prioritize pubmed_id when both pubmed_id and doi are available, otherwise use doi. Only include rows where canonical_smiles is not null and at least one of pubmed_id or doi is present. Join docs using activities.doc_id = docs.doc_id. Left join compound_records using activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Apply DISTINCT to the final projection over exactly the specified columns to avoid duplicate rows from many-to-many joins.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles,
    cr.compound_key AS compound_key,
    CASE WHEN d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT) ELSE d.doi END AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    a.standard_type AS standard_type,
    a.standard_relation AS standard_relation,
    a.standard_value AS standard_value,
    a.standard_units AS standard_units,
    a.activity_comment AS activity_comment,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284'
    AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
    AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
    AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
    AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
